# name: # Schemas learned by exi::infer (cargo test --features infer --test infer -- --ignored)
# Schema-informed without strict: the productions EXI adds (EXI 8.5.4.4.1)
# The XHTML5 profile schema, version 1, without strict (Appendix D): pages as XHTML
# Codings: the byte-aligned fixtures again, bit-packed (-bitp), pre-compressed (-pre) and compressed (-comp)
# Blocks and channels: values per block, the 100-value threshold, string tables in channel order
# Left out: nil-strict and types-strict with pre-compression or compression and blocks of 1
# and 3 values, and zerobits-strict with compression and blocks of 110 values. EXIficient 1.0.7
# leaves values out of those streams and cannot decode them itself.
# The channels schema learned by exi infer --exact. Its rare and note channels hold one
# enumerated value each, so their values take no octets: EXIficient writes an empty DEFLATE
# stream for that group, which EXI 9.3 says not to do, and cannot read streams without it.
# Empty DEFLATE streams: where EXIficient writes them (see src/coding/block.rs). bigonly has no
# channel of at most 100 values; onevalue's k channel holds one enumerated value, so it
# takes no octets; zero60 with blocks of 60 ends with a block of zero-bit EE and ED.
# Canonical EXI (EXI C14N), against EXIficient's CANONICAL_EXI and UTC_TIME
# Preserve.lexicalValues with a schema: strings with the restricted character sets of EXI Table 7-2
# Strict lexical xsi:type differs from EXIficient (see LLM.md).
